# Copilot Instructions for Nuxt 4 Starter

## Project Overview

This is a Nuxt 4 application using the modern app directory structure. The project emphasizes clean, simple HTML tags over utility classes.

## Architecture

- **Framework**: Nuxt 4.2.0 with Vue 3.5.22
- **Directory Structure**: Uses Nuxt's app/ directory convention
  - `app/pages/` - File-based routing
  - `app/assets/css/` - Global styles
  - `public/` - Static assets
- **Build Tool**: Vite with TypeScript support

## Styling Guidelines

⚠️ **IMPORTANT**: Use Tailwind CSS utility classes for styling as you wish. There are no restrictions—use any Tailwind features, colors, gradients, or utilities you prefer. Inline styles are allowed if needed.

- Tailwind CSS v4 is installed and can be used for any styling purpose
- Use Tailwind utility classes for layout, spacing, borders, typography, colors, gradients, and more
- Global styles go in `app/assets/css/main.css` if needed

## Development Workflow

```bash
# Development server
pnpm run dev

# Build for production
pnpm run build

# Generate static site
pnpm run generate

# Preview production build
pnpm run preview
```

## File Organization Patterns

- **Pages**: `app/pages/index.vue` - follows Nuxt file-based routing
- **Assets**: `app/assets/css/main.css` - global styles with Tailwind import (use Tailwind classes minimally)
- **Config**: `nuxt.config.ts` - includes Tailwind Vite plugin (keep for compatibility but avoid using Tailwind)

## TypeScript Configuration

- Uses project references pointing to `.nuxt/tsconfig.*.json` files
- Auto-generated by Nuxt - do not modify directly
- TypeScript compilation handled by Nuxt's build process

## Key Dependencies

- `@vueuse/core` - Vue composition utilities
- `vue-router` - handled by Nuxt automatically
- Tailwind packages present but should not be used for styling

## Code Patterns

- Use Vue 3 Composition API with `<script setup>`
- Use Tailwind utility classes for layout and spacing
- Follow Nuxt's auto-imports for Vue composables
- Use semantic HTML elements with Tailwind classes

## Example Component Structure

```vue
<template>
  <div class="max-w-4xl mx-auto p-4">
    <header class="border-b pb-2 mb-4">
      <h1 class="text-xl font-bold">Welcome</h1>
    </header>
    <main class="pt-4">
      <!-- content -->
    </main>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup>
// Composition API logic
</script>
```
